title: Safe or Trapped?
excerpt: Countdown Day 16: The more we insiders succeed in shutting others out, the more I tend to feel locked in, caged, trapped. (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 31) Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
body:
Countdown Day 16:

 The more we insiders succeed in shutting others out, the more I tend to feel locked in, caged, trapped.

 (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 31)

Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
